# Tinyqueue

> A durable job queue that lives inside your SQLite file. One binary, no Redis.

## Docs
- [Install](https://tinyqueue.dev/docs/): download the binary and run it next to your app
- [Pricing](https://tinyqueue.dev/pricing): free for one project, paid for teams
- [Blog](https://tinyqueue.dev/blog/): notes on running small queues in production
